title: Camelcase Matching
description: Given an array of strings `queries` and a string `pattern`, return a boolean array `answer` where `answer[i]` is `true` if `queries[i]` matches `pattern`, and `false` otherwise. A query matches `pattern` if we can insert zero or more lowercase English letters anywhere into `pattern` to obtain the query.
constraints: queries[i] and pattern consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters.
hints: Use a two-pointer scan over each query and pattern.
Advance the pattern pointer when characters match; otherwise the query character must be lowercase, or matching immediately fails.

examples.explanation: "FooBar" and "FooBarTest" match "FB", whereas "FootBall" and "ForceFeedBack" contain extra uppercase letters or mismatch.
Inserting lowercase letters into "FoBa" forms "FooBar" and "FootBall" only.
"FooBarTest" matches "FoBaT", while the other queries lack the uppercase 'T'.
